text_block_list.text: While watching a certain race—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
—Seiun Sky pulls away, pulls away, and 
escapes! Seiun Sky pulls off a flawless 
front-running victory!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe... yep. First place is mine♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sei-chan, congratulations! You were so 
amazingly strong!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks Spe-chan! Everything went 
totally according to plan♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, according to plan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? That's a secret~♪ After all, that's 
the secret to Sei-chan's strength.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Did you have some kind of special 
strategy?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ehh, you're curious? What should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Though, next time I run against you, 
Spe-chan, I might just win using the same 
trick again~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The mind games have already begun! Just 
kidding!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you're so tough to read! But I won't 
lose!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yup♪ I'm looking forward to next time too!

On the way home, I spotted the two of them 
again—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hum-de-hum~♪ Phew, glad the concert went 
so well too~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that Sei-chan has a 
different vibe right now compared to 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Usually, you're super smart, and slippery 
like an eel, hard to pin down...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But right now, you feel really 
straightforward and honest!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eh~? You make it sound like usual Sei-chan 
isn't honest at all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah, n-no, that's not what I meant...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. I mean... it just makes me 
happy, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I worked really hard so I could win, after 
all. It's only natural to be happy, 
don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...You know, Sei-chan, you're actually a 
really, truly straightforward person.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A straightforward Sei-chan is just 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Kh. You're the one who's way too 
honest, Spe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sei-chan, are you blushing?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...L-Look, we're gonna break curfew~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gotta go right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fufu, wait up, Sei-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you just how honest Sei-chan can 
be right now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Right now... I'm sleepy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna go to sleep~... *yaaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa, wait up, Sei-chaaan!
